name: hdr-merge
description: Merge 2–4 supplied, already-aligned exposures of a static scene using an assumed sRGB response. Provide distinct relative capture EV values from -4 to 4, including zero; positive values mean greater capture exposure. Export a relative-linear Radiance RGBE HDR image, an SDR Reinhard preview and a report ZIP. Supply opaque JPEG, PNG or WebP files with identical oriented dimensions: 32–1024 pixels per side, 20 MB per file and 32 MB combined. No alignment, deghosting, camera-response fitting, physical calibration, RAW/DNG/EXR/HDR10 export or clipped-detail restoration. Eight-bit processing and camera tone curves can bias results. Requires a connected account; derived exports are public.
